Storage & X-Ray Server

Not Tested

Manage your clinic's local file storage server. Once saved here, connection settings automatically sync to all doctors and clinic devices.

When you save, this connection syncs across the entire clinic instantly. Doctors and staff on other devices connect automatically without typing any URLs.

Use http://localhost:5000 when running on the main clinic PC, or paste your Cloudflare Tunnel HTTPS address for universal access.

Must match the clinic_secret_key specified in your storage server's config.json.

Insert appointment variable

English variables

Arabic variables

How variables work

Click a variable button to insert it at the cursor. English and Arabic aliases both work; keep the double curly brackets unchanged.

{{patient_name}}{{اسم_المريض}}
Becomes the patient’s full name.
{{doctor_name}}{{اسم_الطبيب}}
Becomes the assigned doctor’s name.
{{appointment_date}}{{تاريخ_الموعد}}
Becomes the appointment date without the weekday.
{{appointment_day}}{{يوم_الموعد}}
Becomes the weekday, such as Tuesday or الثلاثاء.
{{appointment_time}}{{وقت_الموعد}}
Becomes the appointment start time.

Voice Scribe Engine (Chairside AI)

Browser STT

Browser STT is the default. Choose Cloud Audio when you want to send a recording to Gemini.

STT sends recognized text to Gemini. Cloud Audio sends a recording and is used only when you select it.

Microphone permission is managed by your browser and device. Choose Allow for this site when available; Lumin cannot suppress browser permission prompts.
